notes.subject: הרע/תרעו
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute plus finite verb of the same root רעע reinforces: 'do evil-doing'; Sepedi rendering repeats sebe with the verb to keep the doubling.

notes.subject: sumošwa
notes.rationale: ספה literally 'sweep/scrape away'; JPS 'swept away', KJV 'consumed' — sumošwa captures the sweeping-away picture.

notes.subject: setšhaba sa Yisraele
notes.rationale: Moeši Moshe o bolela ka go se šišinye le setšhaba ka noši; tlhoso ya pelong ya temana ye.

translation: Eupša ge le ka ntšha sebe, le lona gabedi le kgoši ya lena le tla sumošwa.
